title: sundamomum calyptratum
intro: Sundamomum calyptratum, commonly known as the "island kava", is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands. It is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, where it has been traditionally used to relieve anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The health benefits of Sundamomum calyptratum include reducing stress and promoting relaxation, and its therapeutic actions include sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
